title: When the Lantern Wakes
author: A. M. Iversen
blurb: Oscar Yarrow, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
